column1: # Slice 307 (CALL-WHOLE-ARGUMENTS-STRUCTURE), try a24 -- a23 with the applicability of a candidate kind-strict at the leaves. The probe
# p307l on a23 (tool170e, rt170f, fe170p): whole_arguments 7 and whole_overlap_held held in both executors, both roots; the probe
# programs wl_b, wl_c, wl_d run 7 in both executors; the probe whole_leaf_convert -- a Structure field with a char leaf at a formal whose
# model has int, the program with the char -> int receiver -- was admitted by the conversion-aware applicability of a23 and both
# executors stopped R0 at run time (an uncaught implicit throw: the entry reception of the field is kind-strict). lm_compiler_whole_applicable
# keeps the Consumer-relative projection (uses selected for the callee's input, the requirement's used paths projected into the candidate)
# and compares the leaves as lm_compiler_descriptor_used does; the conversion table at nested leaves is recorded as a remainder shared by
# the ordinary admission and the executors, the probe its evidence (a refuses row since a24: "implements is false in function argument").
